records.name: ImageFlow
records.tagline: Free Photoshop-grade image editor with AI features
records.description: A free, full-featured image editor that runs entirely in your browser. Layers, masks, blend modes, adjustment layers, smart objects, text and filters — with PSD import and export, and on-device AI selection. Nothing is uploaded; your files never leave your device.

records.name: StudyQuest
records.tagline: Turn your notes into games
records.description: Turn PDFs, slides, images, or pasted notes into AI-generated questions, then learn through 40+ games. Battle bosses, race friends, or practice solo using your own material. Teachers can review a question set once, share it for independent play, or host it live with the class. Free plan available.

records.name: Walrus Console
records.tagline: Store, Protect and Connect Your Data
records.description: Put your data to work across apps and AI tools, and keep building on it as your stack evolves. Walrus Console pairs familiar file management with an AI-ready data foundation that is portable, programmable, and verifiable. Free up to 5 GB.

records.name: Velozity
records.tagline: The Multiplayer AI Office where your team and agents work.
records.description: Your team chats in one app, meets in another, and every AI works alone. Velozity brings it all into one place. Chat, audio and video calls with transcripts, tasks, calendar and files, plus AI agents (Claude, Codex, etc.) on the subscriptions you already pay for. Every agent shares the same context, so work moves between people and agents without having to re-explain. For startups, teams in dev, product, sales, and ops, or solo users juggling several AIs. No second AI bill. Free to start.

records.name: IrisGo for Solopreneurs
records.tagline: AI workflow automation: show it once, let it run
records.description: IrisGo helps solopreneurs automate recurring work. Get daily briefs, triage email, track to-dos, and turn demonstrated tasks into reusable workflows with Watch & Learn. Spend less time on admin and more time building your business. Free during beta.

records.name: Rool
records.tagline: Your private AI machine. Files, ideas, AI in one workspace.
records.description: Rool is your private AI workspace. Bring your files, ideas and AI together in one place, on your own machine in the cloud. Unlike mainstream AI, Rool never sells your data, shows no ads and never uses your content to train AI. Your data is stored in Finland, under EU law. It's AI that runs on your terms, with full control and privacy. Built for privacy-conscious individuals, teams and creators. Try Rool free and own your AI.

records.name: Figma Agent
records.tagline: Prompt, edit and prototype without leaving the canvas
records.description: Figma's agent lives right on the Design canvas and works with your real components, variables and team files, not flat images. Generate layout directions, bulk-edit across screens, turn comments into changes and build prototypes from a prompt. Pull context from Notion, Slack, GitHub and Linear via MCP, build your own plugins and shaders, and save repeatable workflows as skills your team runs with "/". Stay in flow from idea to review.

records.name: Zavi
records.tagline: Lovable for growth
records.description: Lovable made building an app feel like typing a sentence. Getting people to use what you built still feels like a full-time job. That’s the gap Zavi is for. Paste your URL and Zavi gives you a growth score and the biggest thing holding you back. Then, if you want, it does the work itself and shows you what moved. For launch, Zavi is running Upcar’s growth for 30 days with $25K of real money and no pause button. Every decision is public.

records.name: Pegasus 1.6 by TwelveLabs
records.tagline: Transforms egocentric video into robot training data
records.description: Pegasus 1.6 is the TwelveLabs model that understands video from a first-person point of view, built for the egocentric and teleoperated footage robotics and physical AI teams already collect. It recognizes entities more accurately, and produces persistent metadata across segment types. Point it at raw teleoperation or wearable footage and get back labeled, timestamped, robot-ready data. No manual labeling pass required.

records.name: GenPage 3.0
records.tagline: Build, personalize, and optimize landing pages with AI
records.description: Your marketing campaigns are personalized. Your landing pages should be too. GenPage learns your brand, builds dedicated pages for every ad, keyword, or target account, then continuously A-Z tests them on Autopilot - turning more traffic into pipeline and revenue.

records.name: Plugins Radar
records.tagline: Search rankings and competitor alerts for ChatGPT plugins
records.description: Plugins Radar tracks the ChatGPT plugin directory. Look up any of 5,000+ plugins to see where it ranks in 192 common searches, which plugins compete with it and which searches it misses. Add your plugin and the rivals you watch, and get an email when one passes you or edits its listing. Topic leaderboards are free. Sign up free and track a plugin to see its full report.

records.name: Reika
records.tagline: A coding agent CLI designed around small local models first
records.description: Reika is a coding agent CLI for local and hosted models, designed around local models first. It doesn't make a small model more intelligent but it provides a better experience using them day to day. Even if you're not part of the absolute range that Reika is designed for, using larger local models or hosted ones will still provide a solid experience out of the box.

records.name: Albie
records.tagline: An AI tutor that teaches at a whiteboard, not a chat box
records.description: Albie teaches on a whiteboard you share: you write with a pen, he reads your handwriting and draws as he explains. Talk or chat with him. He gives quick quizzes, sets homework, codes with you, opens your web projects in-lesson, and builds small apps.

records.name: Takweem AI
records.tagline: The AI calendar that makes room for your most important work
records.description: Takweem is an AI-first calendar. Ask in plain language, or by voice, to find time, move meetings or protect focus. You see every change before it counts: requests that only touch your own time are applied at once with Undo, and anything involving other people waits for your approval. It adapts when plans change, holds a weekly focus goal, and offers team availability and booking links where AI picks the best time. Integrates with Google Calendar — Outlook coming soon.

records.name: Thalia
records.tagline: Plan, approve and review your Muse Code agent on Mac
records.description: Thalia is a free native Mac app for Meta's Muse Code CLI. Plan mode restarts Muse read-only until you approve the plan. Every command is shown in full, step by step, before Allow. Review lets you run your checks and approve the exact snapshot, and any later edit invalidates it. Checkpoints, MCP connectors, voice mode and an embedded terminal are built in. Uses your own Muse access, sends no telemetry, and runs on Apple Silicon Macs with macOS 27.

records.name: Vresk
records.tagline: One AI workspace that offers the best open source models
records.description: Vresk is one AI workspace for open models, from Kimi and DeepSeek to Qwen and Llama. Auto picks the best model for each task, and your notes, history and memory stay in your workspace, so you can switch models without starting over. Ask for an answer, a live widget or a designed deck. Every reply names the model that wrote it. Free to try, $20/mo flat.

records.name: Ana by Vertice
records.tagline: The AI negotiation agent for software purchases
records.description: Ana runs software negotiations on your behalf. It reads your requirements, builds the strategy, drafts every email and tracks every round, updating the plan the moment a vendor responds. Trained on $75bn+ of vendor spend, 32,000+ vendors and 2M+ price points. Procurement buyers using Ana achieve 18% savings on average. Built by Vertice.

records.name: Linda
records.tagline: Your local AI coworker for the Mac, like Dots but free!
records.description: Linda is a free, private AI coworker for your Mac. Say or type what you need and it does the work in its own browser and your folders: research, price checks, pages, sheets, renamed files, replies. Set up specialists, like a Researcher or a Bookkeeper, with their own instructions and skills. Watch every step in the Computer column and take over any time. It runs local AI on Apple Silicon or uses your own key, and asks before it sends, buys, deletes or posts. No account.

records.name: DevAlly AI Agent
records.tagline: User journeys captured with natural language
records.description: Describe a user journey in plain English. The DevAlly Agent navigates your app and records a user journey, saving hours of engineering work. The DevAlly platform then audits each stage of journey against the WCAG criterion and suggests fixes for every issue. Constant changes, requires consistent accessibility monitoring. Our agent does it for you.

records.name: Viibeo
records.tagline: One prompt to a publish-ready faceless short
records.description: Viibeo turns a prompt, page URL, or script into a publish-ready faceless short with a hook-led script, voiceover, B-roll, and timed captions. Export a 9:16 MP4 or use Autopilot to run recurring content for supported social channels. Inspiration Feed helps you find formats worth remaking, while Ad Factory turns product stills into short ad creatives. Your first video is free with a watermark; paid plans start at $19/month.

records.name: Unprompt
records.tagline: Your AI usage in dollars and liters of water
records.description: From the local logs of Claude Code, Codex and Cursor, Unprompt shows your AI usage as tokens, dollars at API prices and liters of water. The Mac companion is free. On iPhone, Unprompt counts how often you use your AI apps, through Screen Time. Work hours are shown separately. Compare your month with friends. Today's tokens and cost are free. The 30-day card with water comes with Premium.

records.name: Proofsource
records.tagline: AI search visibility, with agents that fix the gaps
records.description: When a buyer asks ChatGPT for the best tool in your category, it names five or six companies and stops. Proofsource shows whether you're one of them. It asks your buyers' questions on ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews every day, shows who gets named instead and why, maps the pages AI trusts, and drafts the fixes. You approve; our agents publish, verify the answers changed, and learn from every change. Start free: 25 questions, 4 engines, no card.

records.name: Supademo AI Demo Agent
records.tagline: Agentic demos like your best salesperson, without the salary
records.description: Most AI demo agents feel like a video call where the other side isn't really listening. Silly animated avatar or obvious fake person on the other end. You ask a question, they keep talking. You try to navigate, but you're just watching their screen. Why bother? Supademo's AI Demo Agent is the opposite. Buyers click through real interactive demos hands-on, take any path, jump back, skip ahead. The agent listens, answers the actual question, surfaces the right proof. Voice or text, 50+ languages.

records.name: SunSed
records.tagline: The first AI app builder with a language made for AI
records.description: Other platforms make AI write in languages designed for human programmers. SunSed's language was designed for AI: fewer decisions per step, up to 20x fewer tokens, far fewer errors, richer apps. You can master it in an afternoon. Batteries included: hosting and CDN, database, logins with 2FA, email, file storage, Stripe payments with 0% platform fee, scheduled jobs, custom domains, 60+ integrations. Nothing to wire together. Your live app stays up even when AI credits run out. Free for 7 days.

records.name: Databench by Alkera
records.tagline: Open-source collaborative agentic workspace for data teams
records.description: Databench by Alkera is the open-source, multiplayer workspace for data science, analytics, and engineering. Collaborate live alongside teammates and agents in notebooks and chats, run any cell or agent on your laptop, another computer, or a GPU node and launch many agents in parallel to explore ideas. Every result traces back to the data and code behind it. Try it at https://alkera.ai with a generous free tier or host Databench yourself (https://github.com/AlkeraAI/Databench).

records.name: Rhem Labs
records.tagline: Health assistant robots for your parents’
records.description: Aging at home has a visibility problem. Small changes in health and routine can go unnoticed for weeks or months, until the first obvious sign is something serious. Rhem is a tabletop robot that helps families see those changes earlier, while giving parents the everyday support they need to stay independent longer. Rhem was designed first for aging parents, but anyone can use it as an extra set of eyes and everyday help at home.

records.name: Nano Banana 2.1
records.tagline: Google's image model with sharper design and mask editing
records.description: Nano Banana 2.1 is Google's latest image generation and editing model. Google says it outperforms earlier Nano Banana models across the board, with better visual design, mask based editing, stronger subject consistency and more natural looking images. It also improves text rendering and consistency across turns, with Search grounding at 1K, 2K and 4K. Try it in Google AI Studio or the Gemini app, or build with it in the Gemini API and Google Cloud.

records.name: Ownfeed
records.tagline: A social feed of people who need your product
records.description: Paste your product's URL. Every day, Ownfeed reads Reddit, X, Bluesky and Hacker News and keeps only the posts from people who need what you built. No keywords, no alert inbox, no auto-replies. You scroll for five minutes and reply yourself.

records.name: Lofi Desk 2.0
records.tagline: A pixel-art focus companion and a room you decorate
records.description: Lofi Desk is a focus timer in a pixel-art room, where PC GIRL works right next to you. 2.0 is our biggest update yet: 🪙 Focus coins — earned for every minute you focus 🛋️ Room decor — spend coins on furniture and make the room yours 👕 Outfits for PC GIRL ✨ Every animation hand-redrawn in pixel art 🎧 Lofi music, rain / café / forest / fireplace ambience, Pomodoro and a focus log Premium is a one-time purchase. No subscription.

records.name: Knuff App
records.tagline: Family check-in app to know your people are okay
records.description: Knuff is a family check-in app that makes it easy to see how your loved ones are doing, even when life gets busy. Create a bubble with your most important people and share quick check-ins to stay connected wherever life takes you. For families and friend groups of all ages. Core features free, optional paid add-ons available. For iOS and Android.

records.name: Redlamp
records.tagline: Native, open-source RAW Lightroom alternative editor for Mac
records.description: Redlamp is a native, open-source RAW photo editor for Apple Silicon, built from scratch in Swift and Metal. Lightroom's workflow, with no subscription and no cloud.

records.name: DailyHub
records.tagline: A personal command center for projects, tasks, and habits.
records.description: A personal command center for people who juggle more than one project at a time — founders, consultants, indie builders, anyone with client work, side projects, and a few non-negotiable daily habits. DailyHub is not a replacement for Linear, Jira, or Notion. It is the morning surface: what is open, what belongs where, what must happen today, and what you already finished.

records.name: Aura by Neural
records.tagline: Turn requests into interactive interfaces on your screen
records.description: A new way to work and create on Mac and Windows. Speak or type, and Aura turns your requests into interactive interfaces on your screen. Bring your files, explore ideas, compare options, and create finished work. Keep talking, and shape what you see.

records.name: Featherweight Dictation
records.tagline: Dictation that weighs nothing, for Mac and Windows
records.description: Hold a key, talk, let go: your words land where your cursor is, ums gone and laid out for the app you're in, an email, a chat line, a list or a prompt. 4.6 MB on a Mac, 2.3 MB on Windows, 0% CPU while it waits. $5 a month after a free trial.

records.name: Flowo
records.tagline: ADHD day planner that re-plans when your day slips
records.description: Most planners help you make a plan. Flowo helps when the plan stops matching the day. It builds your day from tasks, fixed events and limits like sleep and meals, then rebuilds what is left when something runs long, and shows what moved and why. Brain dump by typing or voice, habits that scale down in hard weeks, and a Pomodoro timer that starts from the plan. No account; planning data stays encrypted on your phone. Free on iPhone and Android, with an optional Pro plan.

records.name: Vanoor
records.tagline: Turn your Apple Watch into a serious running watch
records.description: Vanoor turns your Apple Watch into a proper running watch. Follow GPX routes with a tap and a spoken cue before every turn, pace your race split by split, and run structured workouts with pace or heart-rate targets, built in the app or planned by your AI assistant. Afterwards, every split is scored by how closely you ran the plan. Fueling reminders, spoken cues in 11 languages, saves to Apple Health and Strava. No account, no subscription: 7 days free, then buy once.

records.name: Cinch – Reminders & Tasks
records.tagline: Clean, privacy-first task manager for Apple Reminders
records.description: Cinch is a fast, lightweight native client for Apple Reminders across iOS, macOS, watchOS, and visionOS. Built for the future: CLI for Agents – Give LLMs access to your Reminders while keeping all data local and private. Zero telemetry, zero tracking, and no custom databases. Your data stays strictly in your personal iCloud. Clean layout with generous spacing, visual daily timelines, calendar integration, natural language input, and interactive widgets.

records.name: Basedash Mobile
records.tagline: Ask your data out loud, right from your Home Screen.
records.description: Basedash Mobile puts your AI data analyst on your iPhone Home Screen. Add it from Safari in a few taps, hit the mic, and ask out loud — "Which region grew fastest this month?" — to get the answer and a chart in seconds. Tap any bar to drill in by country, plan, or rep, then scrub a trend with your thumb. Sales, finance, support, and ops can check the numbers from a hallway, an airport, or a customer meeting. Your data, in your pocket. Just ask out loud.

records.name: Mistral Large 4
records.tagline: Mistral's 1T parameter open weight frontier model
records.description: Mistral Large 4 (aka Le Chonk) is Mistral's largest model yet: a natively multimodal mixture of experts model with 1T total and 49B active parameters and a 1M token context window. Mistral says it is the strongest open weight model from the US or Europe, and it ranks top 5 on the Artificial Analysis Cyber Index. It was trained in Mistral's own European datacenters. The preview API is live today on Mistral Studio, with open weights due by the end of October.

records.name: Temp Mail
records.tagline: Disposable email + private forwarding to your real inbox
records.description: Temp Mail is back with a big update. Get a free disposable email in one click (no sign-up) for trials, downloads and newsletters. What's new: • Forwarding aliases (Android): hand out a private address, mail lands in your real inbox in seconds, the sender never sees it • Verification codes copied in a tap • Pick your own username and domain, reuse the inbox later • 29 languages, incl. right-to-left Arabic and Urdu • Ad-free website

records.name: Wabi
records.tagline: A new kind of messenger that gets things done
records.description: a new kind of messenger that makes apps and gets things done for you and your friends. We’re building the OS for the agentic era - software that adapts to your life, gets things done, and makes more room for the people and things that matter.

records.name: Introducing Video Editor in Manus 2.0
records.tagline: Anyone Can Now Make A Video Worth Posting
records.description: Manus 2.0 introduces Video Editor, making professional-looking video creation accessible to everyone. After a month of daily use, Manus has been used to create launch films, game trailers, news explainers, beat-synced animations, and even edit travel footage. The new Video Editor combines Manus’ AI video capabilities with powerful editing workflows, helping anyone turn ideas and raw footage into polished videos worth posting.

records.name: Postquel
records.tagline: Free native Postgres app for Mac with your own AI agents
records.description: A fast, native PostgreSQL client for macOS. Its AI assistant runs on the Claude Code, Codex or Cursor account you already pay for, sees your real schema, and can only read: any change it suggests waits for you to dry-run and apply. Free and open source.

records.name: ParakeetAI 2.0
records.tagline: The ultimate way to prepare for your job interview
records.description: ParakeetAI takes you from "what will they ask?" to "I nailed it." Start with the Question Bank: real interview questions grouped by company and ranked by how often they come up. Rehearse them out loud with an AI interviewer that asks, listens and follows up on your answers, then read the transcript back. On the day, ParakeetAI listens to the real interview and drafts your answers live. Your first mock interview is free.

records.name: ImageFlow
records.tagline: Free Photoshop-grade image editor with AI features
records.description: A free, full-featured image editor that runs entirely in your browser. Layers, masks, blend modes, adjustment layers, smart objects, text and filters — with PSD import and export, and on-device AI selection. Nothing is uploaded; your files never leave your device.

records.name: Mundane Read
records.tagline: News, no dramas
records.description: Mundane Read keeps the calm on every news site you read. It measures the writing, not the politics. There is no left-right rating and there will not be one. It does not say whether a story is true; it says how it is told. From Mundane Read, calm and anxiety-free news with the loaded words taken out, at mundaneread.com.

records.name: AEVIX
records.tagline: The whiteboard with a voice AI agent.
records.description: AEVIX is a voice AI whiteboard that turns spoken ideas into clear, editable visual work. Talk naturally to a voice AI agent to create and edit diagrams, plans, explanations, and notes directly on the board. Also, AEVIX understands the full selected visual context of your whiteboard. You can brainstorm, explain, organize, and refine ideas without jumping between chatbots, and manage your work faster and more simply.

records.name: Pi-Bolt
records.tagline: A faster, lighter Pi: the AI coding agent for your terminal
records.description: Pi-Bolt is the Pi coding agent compiled ahead of time into one native executable for Linux and macOS on Apple silicon. Every function becomes machine code when it's built, so nothing is parsed or JIT-compiled at launch. It's ready to type 2-3x sooner than Pi on Bun and uses about a third of the CPU over a session. Your commands, sessions, providers and extensions carry over. Free and open source (MIT).

records.name: ReleaseyourApp
records.tagline: Every app you ship, every asset it needs, in one place.
records.description: Manage every app you ship: versioned store assets, every icon size generated from one master, per-locale listing copy, screenshot conversion and the team roles that keep a release on track.

records.name: StudyQuest
records.tagline: Turn your notes into games
records.description: Turn PDFs, slides, images, or pasted notes into AI-generated questions, then learn through 40+ games. Battle bosses, race friends, or practice solo using your own material. Teachers can review a question set once, share it for independent play, or host it live with the class. Free plan available.

records.name: Subturtle
records.tagline: Speak the English you hear and read, anywhere online
records.description: Learn English from what you already watch and read. Hover a subtitle on YouTube or Netflix, or select text on any web page, and see what it means in your own language, idioms and all. Save the phrase with the sentence it came from. Smart Review brings it back at the right time, as a gap in your own sentence, so it sticks. Then an AI voice coach practices those exact phrases with you out loud, so the words are there when you need them.

records.name: Chatydesk
records.tagline: Run your whole client business inside WhatsApp
records.description: Chatydesk turns WhatsApp into a full front desk for client businesses and creators: a shared team inbox, contacts and pipelines that update themselves, in-chat bookings synced to Google Calendar, and Stripe payments taken right in the conversation. On the official WhatsApp Business API.

records.name: Supplier Catalog Change Checker
records.tagline: Compare supplier CSV prices and flag product changes
records.description: Compare two authorized supplier CSV catalogs by SKU. Get JSON and CSV reports of normalized unit-price changes, packaging changes, added or removed products, and uncertain records requiring review. Built for procurement workflows and AI agents through Apify. No scraping or LLM calls. $3 per completed comparison, including review reports, with platform usage included. Export Excel tables to CSV first.

records.name: ChromaBoard
records.tagline: Define your color language.
records.description: Chroma is a visual workspace for creating, organizing, and refining color palettes. Build consistent color systems, explore combinations, save references, and keep your visual language organized in one place. Designed for creators and designers who want faster access to the right colors without losing consistency across projects.

records.name: Puzzler Plaza
records.tagline: Find your next favorite online puzzle.
records.description: Puzzler Plaza is a curated directory for people who want to find a good online puzzle without digging through endless search results. Browse games by topic, explore newly added titles, check editorial rankings, or use Shuffle when you simply want a surprise. Each listing explains what the game asks you to do and links to its official site, while published checks help you understand whether it is still live and how it plays.

records.name: Moldova Company Financial Statements
records.tagline: Official Moldovan company financials as clean JSON
records.description: Turn Moldova's public depository of financial statements into clean JSON: revenue, net profit, assets, equity, headcount and full reports. Search by company name or IDNO, or export in bulk. Built for due diligence and lead generation.

records.name: WhatsApp Clone App Development
records.tagline: Turn Real-Time Conversations Into a Business Platform
records.description: Bring your messaging app idea to life with a ready development foundation built for modern communication. WhatsApp Clone App Development combines real-time messaging, group chats, media sharing, push notifications, user management, and backend integration. Customize the platform around your audience, business model, and growth plans while creating a familiar experience that keeps users connected and engaged.

records.name: Lead Atlas — Find your next opportunity
records.tagline: PAYG local business leads. No subscription. Pay as you go.
records.description: Lead Atlas is a PAYG business lead generation tool that helps you find targeted businesses by type and location. Search Google Maps data, discover harder-to-find businesses, and enhance leads with public emails, phone numbers, contact names and social profiles. Export your results to CSV and avoid receiving the same leads again. No monthly subscription — pay only for the leads delivered. Try up to 100 standard leads completely free, with no card required.

records.name: Wallpaper Rotator: Auto Change
records.tagline: A battery-friendly automatic4K wallpaper changer for Android
records.description: Transform your Android screen automatically without draining your battery! Wallpaper Rotator is a lightweight utility that refreshes your home and lock screens at custom intervals (15 mins to daily). Mix curated 4K categories (AMOLED, minimalist, nature) with personal gallery photos to build custom playlists. Built-in smart power-saving automatically pauses rotation when the screen is off or battery is low, ensuring near-zero idle drain. Optimized scaling for foldables and tablets.

records.name: Goskyscout
records.tagline: Compare flights worldwide with practical route guides
records.description: Goskyscout combines worldwide flight comparison with practical route guides. Compare current flight options and explore airports, baggage considerations, connections and arrival transport before booking with your chosen airline or travel agency. Our initial guides focus on UAE routes.

records.name: SEODojo
records.tagline: See if AI recommends you, and get the page that fixes it
records.description: SEODojo checks what ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google's AI answers say about your brand and shows which AI bots read your site. Then it researches, writes and publishes the article that gets you named. Free plan, no card needed.

records.name: WhatsApp Clone App
records.tagline: Build Your Own Messaging App With WhatsApp-Style Features
records.description: WhatsApp Clone App Development helps businesses build their own branded messaging platform with a familiar chat experience and a custom technology stack. From real-time messaging and media sharing to user management, notifications, and third-party integrations, we develop the app around your business model, UI, and market requirements.

records.name: ChatGPT Mastry Guide
records.tagline: 50+ Practical ChatGPT Prompts to Boost Your Productivity
records.description: Learn how to unlock the full potential of ChatGPT with 50+ practical, real-world prompts and workflows. Designed for creators, freelancers, and entrepreneurs looking to automate tasks, generate creative ideas, and double their daily productivity. Inside this guide: 50+ tested and proven ChatGPT prompts Step-by-step framework for writing better prompts Time-saving workflows for digital creators and marketers

records.name: Ghostpane
records.tagline: Look professional in meetings with invisible screen notes
records.description: Ghostpane is a lightweight desktop utility designed to keep your private notes, scripts, and references invisible while screen-sharing in online meetings. Look confident and speak effortlessly without the awkward eye shifts or accidental leaks. Ghostpane lets you overlay essential information directly on your screen while ensuring meeting participants and screen-capture tools only see what you want them to see. Perfect for technical interviews, client presentations, and remote meetings.

records.name: OfficeSquats
records.tagline: Squat breaks for your Mac, with camera-counted reps
records.description: Turn desk time into short movement breaks. OfficeSquats runs from your Mac menu bar, prompts a full-screen break, and counts squats with on-device camera processing. Set your schedule and rep target, delay breaks during meetings, and track your progress. Try three squats free, then unlock lifetime access with one purchase.

records.name: N95 and KN95 Masks
records.tagline: Understanding The Differences In Protection And Performance
records.description: Among high-quality protective masks, N95 and KN95 masks are two of the most popular choices thanks to their excellent ability to filter dust and airborne particles. Although they are widely used in healthcare settings as well as everyday life, many people are still unclear about their similarities and differences. Let’s take a closer look at these two types of masks with Thien Bang below.

records.name: The Little Door
records.tagline: A tiny door that gives you one message a day.
records.description: There's a small door on a black page. You knock. It opens once, shows you one message, and asks you to come back tomorrow. That's the whole website. No accounts, no tracking, no feed. One visitor, one message, one day.

records.name: EstateView 3D
records.tagline: A photorealistic 3D map of Metro Vancouver for house hunters
records.description: EstateView 3D is a photorealistic 3D map of Metro Vancouver for house hunters. Explore the city with real rendered 3D buildings — tap any listing and the camera flies you to the building, so you see the home in its true context. The sunlight simulator scrubs 6:00–20:00 to show real sun position and shadows. Gold crane pins mark pre-construction projects. Dinani Group (Royal LePage) listings are featured. Check nearby schools, parks, groceries and transit — free for buyers.

records.name: Apical
records.tagline: Your calendar, tasks, mail, notes and health in one day view
records.description: Most planners do one thing well and leave you opening five more apps to get through a normal day. Apical puts tasks and calendar events on one timeline, so it can warn you before you double-book yourself. Around that: notes you can type or handwrite, mail from Gmail, Outlook and iCloud in a single inbox, a grocery list that reminds you when you are near the shop instead of at 9am, and your Apple Health numbers sitting beside the schedule they affect. iPhone, iPad, and any browser.

records.name: StudyOS

records.name: Photo Abstract Editorial

records.name: Will It Jev?
records.tagline: Before you call an LLM, ask: Will It JEV?
records.description: Most LLM routers are Python wrappers or cloud proxies that add tens of milliseconds before a request reaches the model. Jev-router is an in-process, zero-allocation native Rust engine that classifies and assigns routes in under 5 ms. Its deterministic fallback cascade uses byte-level automata, subword classifiers, and closed-form evaluators before escalating to an embedding model or LLM. Simple requests are resolved locally, without touching either.

records.name: Serve

records.name: Robotron

records.description: Robotron is a JARVIS-style voice assistant you can talk to in Hindi, Hinglish or English. • Opens apps and websites with your voice • Reads the page you're on • Sends WhatsApp messages and makes calls • Controls your Android phone from your PC • Always asks before sending a message or placing a call Works on Windows 10/11 and Android. Try a few commands free before you pay.

records.name: DispatchAI

You approve every estimate before the customer sees it. Keep your existing number. English, Spanish, and 5 more languages.

records.name: Tenant AI

records.description: Transform tenant operations with AI tenant management platform. Automate resident communication, tenant screening, workflows, and fraud detection.

Built-in analytics show what actually converts. Works with Webflow forms, Zapier and webhooks.

records.name: Prism
records.tagline: One local gateway for every AI coding agent and LLM
records.description: Prism is a free, open-source tray app that lets Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and 11 more agents use any model provider. One MCP endpoint, free local web search, one-click setup. Single small binary for Windows, macOS and Linux.

records.name: acp-sandbox
records.tagline: A free mock merchant for testing AI shopping-agent checkouts
records.description: If you're building an AI shopping/checkout agent, there's no sandbox for testing it — so I built one. acp-sandbox is a free mock merchant implementing the Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP, backed by OpenAI/Stripe/Meta): real schema conformance for the checkout_sessions lifecycle, no signup, no real money, plus a dashboard to inspect every request/response your agent sends. Already used by a real payment-infrastructure founder who said it did exactly what he needed.

records.name: Captions Bro
records.tagline: Auto Captions, Video Editor & Teleprompter
records.description: Captions Bro is more than an auto-caption app — it combines on-device transcription, a built-in teleprompter, and a full multi-track video editor in one iPhone/iPad workflow. Record your script, generate and style captions, edit clips, add overlays, transitions, and effects, then export for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts. No switching between separate caption, teleprompter, and editing apps.

records.name: PixGrav
records.tagline: Prepare images for professional laser engraving
records.description: PixGrav is a web-based toolkit for preparing images for laser engraving. It combines cropping, enhancement, background removal, image adjustment, perimeter creation, vectorization, dithering and line-art tools in one workflow. Designed for CO₂ and fiber laser users, PixGrav helps turn photos and graphics into cleaner, engraving-ready artwork for LightBurn, RDWorks, EZCAD and other laser software.

records.name: ScriptLix
records.tagline: Screenplay coverage and a writing studio
records.description: Free AI coverage for your screenplay in about twenty seconds. Paste a scene or upload a draft and you get a 1 to 100 score, what's working, and the first thing to fix. No account. Then open Studio, a free screenplay editor in the browser that formats as you type, and rescore after every rewrite. There are also 100+ free tools for writers (format checker, FDX to PDF, name generators) and a new scene picked every day. Your script never trains a model.

records.name: Unicorn Panel
records.tagline: A modern hosting control panel built for fleet management.
records.description: Self-hosted, multi-server hosting control panel, with reseller functionality. Manage every containerized website, database, mailbox and DNS zone across your fleet from one control panel. It can run a full first-party stack with its own web server, mail suite, SQL server, and authoritative DNS, while still supporting familiar tools like NGINX, Apache, OpenLiteSpeed, MariaDB, MySQL, PostgreSQL, and WordPress.

records.name: FaceTwin
records.tagline: Celebrity lookalikes & face analysis that never upload you
records.description: One selfie, three results: your top 5 celebrity lookalikes (with the traits you share), a 1-10 face analysis that explains every number (symmetry, golden ratio, thirds, canthal tilt, jaw, face shape), and AI caricatures in 6 styles. The free parts run entirely in your browser - your photo is never uploaded, no sign-up. First HD caricature free; then one-time credits, no subscription.

records.name: powarca
records.tagline: Convert files in your browser — nothing ever uploaded
records.description: Every online converter uploads your file, processes it on a server and sends it back — which costs the operator money per file, so they cap the size, add queues or make you sign up. powarca does the work inside your browser tab instead: images, audio and PDFs, 15 languages, no account, no queue, no file-size limit. Free, funded by ads that appear after the conversion rather than in front of it.

records.name: LastRetry
records.tagline: Recover failed Stripe payments. Pay only when it works.
records.description: LastRetry reads why each subscription payment failed and plans around it. Insufficient funds get a retry after payday. Expired cards get no blind retries, just an email in your name with a one-tap card update page that charges the invoice right away. Bank confirmations go straight to 3-D Secure. You pay 5 to 10% of what's recovered and nothing otherwise.

records.name: Kratos XT
records.tagline: The private car logbook that knows what your car needs
records.description: Kratos XT keeps your car's whole life in one place (fuel, services, documents, costs and trips) and tells you what's next. A 0 to 100 health score explains every lost point. An AI mechanic answers from your car's own records. Trips log themselves when you drive. No ads, no tracking, no account: your records stay on your phone. Free to start; Pro is a one-time $9.99.

records.name: Hatchling Investor
records.tagline: Stock Analysis For Beginners.
records.description: Hatchling Investor is a beginner-friendly stock analysis platform that explains complex financial metrics, ranks companies by important figures, and helps you make more confident investing decisions. We believe that the current market for stock analysis tools makes it too complicated so we aim to make it both easier to digest as well as teach the user how to find the best stocks along the way.

records.name: proofpluse
records.tagline: Turn customer love into high-converting social proof
records.description: ProofPulse helps founders and creators turn customer praise into conversion power. Collect testimonials via a clean dedicated form, manage approvals in a central inbox, and embed high-converting review widgets on any website in seconds. Key Features: - Multiple Layouts (Carousels, Grids, Wall of Love) - Full White-Labeling (Remove watermarks on Pro) - One-line embed code (Compatible with WordPress, Webflow, Framer, and React) - Freemium tier available

records.name: File Zain

records.description: File Zain is a free suite of 60+ file tools — PDF converters, mergers, splitters, compressors, image/audio/video tools, ZIP archives, QR codes and more — running 100% in your browser. Your files are NEVER uploaded to any server. Everything is processed locally: no accounts, no upload queues. • 60+ tools, free forever • Private by design — zero uploads • 7 languages incl. Arabic, Kurdish, Persian • Works on phone and desktop, no install needed Built by an independent maker from Iraq.

records.name: Trackdown
records.tagline: Count the days that matter
records.description: Countdowns and count ups that feel like they came with your iPhone. Every event gets a dial, milestones earn medals, and widgets keep your next big day on your Home Screen and Lock Screen. No account, no tracking, nothing leaves your phone. Free.

records.name: Bouncify
records.tagline: Verify emails, clean lists, and reduce email bounces
records.description: Bouncify helps businesses verify email addresses, clean email lists, reduce invalid addresses and hard bounces, and improve email deliverability. Verify lists in bulk or use the API for real-time validation. Get 100 free verification credits to test Bouncify.

records.name: Inspector
records.tagline: Catch Windows processes that flash and disappear
records.description: Inspector is a local-first Windows investigation tool for short-lived processes. It captures command lines, parent chains, hashes and process lifetimes through Sysmon, correlates persistence, and turns the evidence into an interactive HTML report. No cloud. No telemetry. Open source.

records.name: VartaLang
records.tagline: India's Language Bridge
records.description: Learn languages by connecting with real people across India. Our platform features an advanced in-chat translation plugin powered by Sarvam AI speech integration, ensuring seamless colloquial, code-mixed translation for India's diverse dialects. It is an economic and language bridge built for India.

records.name: Hotel Lobby AI Filter

records.description: Turn two photos into a 15-second vertical rap duet on an orange stage—no prompts or editing timeline needed. Try one free 480P preview, then choose 720P or 1080P MP4 downloads with the soundtrack included. Signed-in users can revisit their generation history. Available in six languages, with one-time credit packs and clear per-video costs. An independent creative tool for unexpected duos, from friends to pets.

records.name: TenderProcure
records.tagline: Verified Government & Private Tenders in India
records.description: Search live & verified Government, GeM, PSU & private tenders across India. Get AI summaries of tender documents + email alerts. Start free today.

records.name: Space on Live
records.tagline: See where you are in the solar system, right now
records.description: Most of us spend our days zoomed in on a six-inch screen. Meanwhile Earth is racing around the Sun at 107,000 km/h, and the light on your desk left the Sun 8 minutes ago. Space on Live zooms you out: a live 3D view of where you are, right now.

records.name: PuzzleToolbox
records.tagline: Less stuck. More solving. Free puzzle tools.
records.description: One stubborn puzzle shouldn’t derail your break. PuzzleToolbox brings free online puzzle solvers together so you can get help and get back to playing. Find tools for Block Blast, word searches, cryptograms, Caesar ciphers, nonograms, Picross, and more—all in one place, with no signup required. Whether checking an answer or tackling a tricky grid, pick the solver that matches your puzzle at https://puzzletoolbox.com/.

records.name: Resale IQ
records.tagline: Free tools + price intelligence for secondhand sellers
records.description: Resale IQ gives secondhand sellers free tools plus price intelligence. Free: fee and profit calculators for 9 platforms (eBay, Depop, Poshmark, Mercari, Vinted, Etsy, Grailed and more), a Google Sheets profit tracker, shipping and tax-threshold checkers, an embeddable calculator and a reseller supply store. Paid: BUY/WATCH/SKIP signals with a max price to pay, from live Vinted EU listings, for people who buy stock to resell. 3 free checks, no account.

records.name: RestaKit
records.tagline: Own your restaurant software. Add any feature with AI
records.description: Restaurant software is usually rented, and you cannot change it. Connect to an AI app builder to add any feature, use your own developer, or we change for you for a fee. No coding knowledge needed. We back you at every step.

Fixed prices: a Drop of 20 images for AED 3,500, a Campaign of 50 for AED 7,500, or Always-on at 60 images a month. Built in Dubai for UAE and Gulf brands and the agencies serving them.

records.description: ChatTruX-AI — a fast, secure intelligent AI workspace for deep thinking and focused work. TruX-Code ---> Fully specialized coding workspace within AI, Direct coding support to github via plugins

records.name: Image Color Remover

Ideal for logos, signatures, green-screen graphics, and flat backgrounds. Everything runs locally in your browser, with no uploads or account.

Free, no sign-up, playable in your browser in seconds.

Free browser demos for every tool.

records.name: Free Calculator
records.tagline: Free online calculators for everyday math and money
records.description: We built 240+ free calculators so you never need a spreadsheet for life's math. Mortgage payments, compound interest, BMI, age, discounts, tips, taxes, and unit conversions, plus developer tools and 148 professional calculators for engineering, finance, and quality work. Everything runs in your browser with results as you type. No account, no signup, and it works on every device. We also offer a calculator API and MCP server so AI assistants can calculate too.

records.name: Noet
records.tagline: Proactive AI that prepares work before you ask
records.description: Noet is a proactive Mac AI assistant for founders and engineers. It brings together context from your work to prepare meeting briefs, reply drafts, and follow-ups before you ask. You review what’s ready and decide whether to edit, send, or act. You can also ask Noet questions and inspect the sources behind its answers. Join the waitlist for early access.

records.name: Vyces: Habit Logger
records.tagline: When habit trackers don’t work
records.description: Most habit trackers are built around goals and streaks: miss a day and the counter drops back to zero. Vyces is a logger. You tap when something happens, even several times a day, or log it from a Home Screen widget. Over time you see how often it happens, on which days and at what hours, and which habits show up on the same days. Daily and weekly reports put it all in one view. No goals, streaks or challenges. Your history stays on your iPhone and syncs only through your own iCloud.

records.name: SIMPLE-SMART Minimal Launcher
records.tagline: Stay SIMPLE by default. Go SMART only when you choose.
records.description: SIMPLE-SMART is a minimalist Android launcher built around one idea: stay SIMPLE by default, then temporarily switch to SMART for 5, 15 or 30 minutes when you actually need the full smartphone. When the timer ends, it automatically returns to SIMPLE. It also includes Activity insights, custom Productive/Neutral/Distraction categories, Rewards, Weather Glass, Living Edge and Light/Dark themes. No ads. No subscription.

records.name: Quick Scan First
records.tagline: Find exposed keys and security risks before you ship
records.description: Quick Scan First scans your GitHub repo for exposed keys, open databases, missing auth and payment bugs, then opens a pull request with the fix.

records.name: Mr. Restoration – 24/7 Restoration
records.tagline: Fast, Professional Restoration When You Need It Most
records.description: Mr. Restoration provides professional 24/7 restoration services for water, fire, and mold damage throughout Nashville and Middle Tennessee. With rapid response, experienced technicians, and IICRC-certified expertise, the company helps homeowners and businesses restore damaged properties quickly and safely.

records.name: AgentID
records.tagline: The sign-in method for AI agents
records.description: AI agents are already signing up for your product with borrowed logins and throwaway emails. AgentID gives every agent its own verified identity, backed by a real email address, and tells you which human owns it. If your app handles Sign in with Google, it can accept AgentID. It is configuration, not code, with guides for Clerk, Supabase, Auth0, Better Auth and Auth.js. Free for apps, no per-sign-in fees. Cap signups per owner, rate-limit per human, and email the agent directly.

records.name: Diva eSIM
records.tagline: Stay connected worldwide with instant travel eSIMs
records.description: Diva eSIM helps travelers stay connected with digital mobile data plans available across 190+ countries. Choose local, regional, or global eSIM plans, install digitally, and get connected without replacing your physical SIM. Diva eSIM is available on the web, iOS, and Android, with instant digital delivery, flexible data options, and a platform built to make international connectivity simpler.

records.name: TransformPipe
records.tagline: Save, share and convert Markdown from your AI assistant
records.description: Convert or share your MD files directly from your AI agent. No need to copy Markdown out of a chat, paste it somewhere or dig through old conversations. TransformPipe is listed in Claude's connector directory: one click, and Claude can save, version,and share what it writes as a finished page, with anyone or only the people you name. Everything lands in one searchable library, whichever chat it came from. Plus 15 file conversions in your browser, never uploaded. Free and open source.

records.name: Trends Radar by GrowthUpdate
records.tagline: Track trends, analyze signals, spot what’s next
records.description: GrowthUpdate Trends Radar helps founders, marketers, product teams, and indie hackers see what is starting to move before it becomes obvious. It combines search trends, product activity, content signals, AI analysis, scoring, and manual curation to surface rising categories and market momentum. Use it to validate ideas, spot new opportunities, follow changing demand, and discover useful SaaS growth tools, tactics, and resources from GrowthUpdate.io

records.name: Meet Anvi
records.tagline: Ad-free learning for kids 3–8, with a parent's view
records.description: Meet Anvi is an ad-free early learning app for kids 3–8 built for active play, not passive screen time. Key features: • Interactive Learning: A–Z phonics, letter tracing, shape matching, counting, drawing, and read-aloud stories with star rewards. • Parent Dashboard: PIN-protected area with screen-time limits, multiple child profiles, and progress tracking. • Pure Privacy: Zero ads, no third-party tracking SDKs, and offline-first activities—a clean, safe space built around children and parents.

records.name: Rudder
records.tagline: A TUI for managing all your coding agents
records.description: Rudder is a TUI for managing coding agents. Run Claude Code, Codex and opencode side by side, each in its own isolated jj workspace. • See which agent needs you and approve prompts • Steer any agent mid-turn, go full screen with ⌥h • /plan a goal into a DAG, /gam a builder with a reviewer • Run the whole dashboard in Rudder Cloud • Merge with one key npm i -g @viraatdas/rudder GitHub: github.com/viraatdas/rudder Free and open source (MIT)

records.name: Cropped
records.tagline: Capture, annotate, trim & compress screenshots and videos
records.description: Cropped is a native screenshot, annotation and screen recording app with a full image and video optimizer built in. Snap an area, window or screen, record at up to 60 fps, mark it up, then export WebP, AVIF, MP4, WebM or GIF at a fraction of the size. Drag results from the floating Drop window straight into Slack, Mail or a browser. Runs locally, originals untouched. Mac & Windows (capture on Apple Silicon first). $24.99 once, updates for life, 14-day free trial with no signup.

records.name: GSS - GPU Style Sheets
records.tagline: Write 3D scenes in CSS, compiled to one GPU shader
records.description: GSS is a 3D language for people who already speak CSS. Declare shapes in a @scene, style them with selectors, the cascade, custom properties, and @keyframes, and the compiler turns it all into a single raymarching shader (GLSL for WebGL2, WGSL for WebGPU). No Three.js, no meshes, no UVs. Drop a tag on any page, or try it live in the playground. Open source, Apache 2.0.

records.name: Vanpelt.studio | The $29 Youtube team
records.tagline: A Youtube creation expert team in a local desktop app
records.description: Creating Youtube videos is hard and requires a lot of skills which is why a lot of big creator have a team for that purpose. What if you could also have a strategist who finds the videos your audience already wants, a writer, two editors and a packaging designer ? Vanpelt Studio is all five, for only $29 a month vs the average $10k you'd spent on an average staff. Beginners trying to get started with the best practices or expert looking to cut down workload, the studio accommodates everyone.

records.name: Basedash Mobile
records.tagline: Ask your data out loud, right from your Home Screen.
records.description: Basedash Mobile puts your AI data analyst on your iPhone Home Screen. Add it from Safari in a few taps, hit the mic, and ask out loud — "Which region grew fastest this month?" — to get the answer and a chart in seconds. Tap any bar to drill in by country, plan, or rep, then scrub a trend with your thumb. Sales, finance, support, and ops can check the numbers from a hallway, an airport, or a customer meeting. Your data, in your pocket. Just ask out loud.

records.name: AI Antique & Coin Identifier
records.tagline: Snap a photo to identify antiques, coins & their value
records.description: Found an old coin, stamp, or antique and wondering what it's worth? Just snap a photo. Our AI identifies antiques, coins, stamps, and jewelry in seconds and shows the item's history, origin, and estimated value. Save every item to your own digital collection, sort it into categories, and export it as a PDF for insurance, selling, or sharing with other collectors. Built for collectors, dealers, and thrift hunters.

records.name: fundsvisor
records.tagline: Books that file themselves. No accountant needed.
records.description: Fundsvisor is a modern invoicing and expense tracker for freelancers and small businesses. Snap a receipt and AI reads the merchant, amount, and category. Send a branded invoice and track delivery + payment. Get plain-English report, Money Summary, Income vs Expenses, P&L, Balance Sheet without ever touching a debit or credit. Pakistan businesses get one-click FBR e-invoicing. Web, iOS, Android. Free plan + 14-day business trial.

records.name: Quick Presenter
records.tagline: A lightweight cross-platform presenter for PDF slides
records.description: Quick Presenter is a lightweight cross-platform presenter tool for PDF slide decks, built for academic talks, research presentations, technical conferences, and online presentations over tools such as Zoom and Google Meet. Quick Presenter focuses on one job: open a PDF slide deck and help the speaker present it reliably. It is not a slide editor, a deck authoring tool, or a document management app.

records.name: VenueCOI
records.tagline: Vendor insurance certificates, collected and AI-checked
records.description: VenueCOI checks vendor certificates of insurance for wedding and event venues. Vendors upload through a link (no login). AI reads each COI and checks liability limits, dates against the event date, additional insured wording and liquor liability, then tells the vendor exactly what to fix and sends reminders. Venues see every vendor as approved, pending or needs a fix. Free COI checker at venuecoi.com/check. First event free.

records.name: Mistral Large 4
records.tagline: Mistral's 1T parameter open weight frontier model
records.description: Mistral Large 4 (aka Le Chonk) is Mistral's largest model yet: a natively multimodal mixture of experts model with 1T total and 49B active parameters and a 1M token context window. Mistral says it is the strongest open weight model from the US or Europe, and it ranks top 5 on the Artificial Analysis Cyber Index. It was trained in Mistral's own European datacenters. The preview API is live today on Mistral Studio, with open weights due by the end of October.

records.name: CURB
records.tagline: Free SF parking map that shows when tickets actually land
records.description: CURB is a free map of San Francisco street parking rules. Every swept curb is colored by its next street sweep. A typical sign gives a two hour window, but about 77% of tickets are written in the first 45 minutes. On most blocks CURB shows when tickets usually land, based on about 815,000 past citations. Push alerts and calendar reminders before a sweep. Web plus a free iPhone app. No account, no ads, no cookies. Open source. San Francisco only. The posted sign always wins.

records.name: Temp Mail
records.tagline: Disposable email + private forwarding to your real inbox
records.description: Temp Mail is back with a big update. Get a free disposable email in one click (no sign-up) for trials, downloads and newsletters. What's new: • Forwarding aliases (Android): hand out a private address, mail lands in your real inbox in seconds, the sender never sees it • Verification codes copied in a tap • Pick your own username and domain, reuse the inbox later • 29 languages, incl. right-to-left Arabic and Urdu • Ad-free website

records.name: Takewell
records.tagline: An iPhone teleprompter that cleans up room echo and noise
records.description: Teleprompter apps scroll a script well. None fix what the script does to your audio: to read off your phone you stand back, and at that distance the mic records the room with you. Takewell runs an open source speech model on the phone after each take, removing background noise and room echo, then levels the volume so nothing clips. On the review screen you flip between the original and the cleaned take and hear it. iOS Free on every take, no credits. Your video and audio stay on the phone.

records.name: Beside
records.tagline: Help visitors use your website
records.description: Beside reads the visitor's page, points at answers, opens pages, clicks when asked and fills fields. Talk or type. Accessibility includes Easy mode, larger text, reading pages and answers aloud, translation and a private link for a friend to help. Developers get automatic bug reports with steps and browser details, plus click, rage-click and scroll heatmaps. Teams can help on screen and correct answers. Connect store data, Stripe, MCP or your own tools. Visitors review and submit forms.

records.name: Blogizi
records.tagline: The blog your AI agent can publish to
records.description: Point Claude, Codex, OpenClaw or Hermes at Blogizi. Your agent drafts the post in markdown; Blogizi ships it to your own domain with SEO, OG images, sitemaps and schema handled. Publish from the CLI, MCP, Obsidian or a skill.

records.name: Wabi
records.tagline: A new kind of messenger that gets things done
records.description: a new kind of messenger that makes apps and gets things done for you and your friends. We’re building the OS for the agentic era - software that adapts to your life, gets things done, and makes more room for the people and things that matter.

records.name: ScsDriver

records.description: ScsDriver 是一款 Windows 工具，将 WebDAV 等远程存储挂载为本地磁盘，像使用本地文件夹一样访问云端文件。

records.name: Zas
records.tagline: Send files, text and code. It deletes itself in 5 days.
records.description: Zas moves files, photos, text and code between your devices and to other people. Nothing to install and no account to start: open zas.red and paste. A universal clipboard: copy on your phone, paste on your computer. Directo sends up to 10 GB device to device. Everything is encrypted on your device before upload and deletes itself in 5 days unless you pin it. Your coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, any MCP client) can send too. Web, Android and iOS. Free to use — a corridor, not a warehouse.

records.name: UEGMusic
records.tagline: Prepare DJ drops, radio jingles and podcast intros
records.description: UEGMusic is a guided workspace for preparing short audio identities: producer tags, DJ drops, radio jingles and podcast intros. Start from text or your own recording, choose intro, background and outro music, and use the form or Agent workflow. Review a server-issued quote before production. Paid plans and checkout are currently disabled.

records.name: Introducing Video Editor in Manus 2.0
records.tagline: Anyone Can Now Make A Video Worth Posting
records.description: Manus 2.0 introduces Video Editor, making professional-looking video creation accessible to everyone. After a month of daily use, Manus has been used to create launch films, game trailers, news explainers, beat-synced animations, and even edit travel footage. The new Video Editor combines Manus’ AI video capabilities with powerful editing workflows, helping anyone turn ideas and raw footage into polished videos worth posting.

records.name: Tarot Mania
records.tagline: AI-powered tarot readings in 9 languages
records.description: Tarot Mania is an AI-powered tarot reading app that delivers personalized card readings in 9 languages. Choose from 10+ spreads — Celtic Cross, Love, Career, Daily — and get deep, meaningful interpretations instantly. Works on all devices, no account required to try.

records.name: Sand Blocks: Drop Puzzle Guide
records.tagline: game,sand blocks
records.description: All 550 Sand Blocks: Drop Puzzle levels - full video walkthroughs, solutions and pull-order tips for every board, from Level 1 to Level 550.

records.name: A Place to Study and Shine
records.tagline: Education Vellore
records.description: Looking for a trusted educational institution in Vellore that focuses on academic excellence and overall student development? BMD JAIN SCHOOL ICSE is a well-regarded institution dedicated to providing quality education through the ICSE curriculum. The school aims to nurture young minds with knowledge, creativity, discipline, and confidence.

records.name: Ejendex
records.tagline: Danish property data, owners and transactions in one place
records.description: Explore Danish properties with BBR building information, ownership, valuations and transaction history in one place. Investigate owners and companies, view company financial statements, browse maps and keep private or team property notes. Start with free property searches, then choose a free account or monthly Premium. Built for Danish real estate professionals, investors and homeowners.

records.name: Adjuntora
records.tagline: AI assistant for accountants. AFIP, DGI, BPS instant answers
records.description: AI assistant for accountants, insurance brokers, and HR professionals. Adjuntora interprets tax notices (AFIP, DGI, BPS), automates compliance tasks, and saves hours of manual work. Built by Barracuda Software for Latin American accounting firms.

records.name: Baby Grow Sense
records.tagline: Baby growth tracker with WHO charts & health tools
records.description: Baby Grow Sense is a parenting companion for tracking your newborn's development. Monitor weight, height, and head circumference with WHO-standard growth charts (Z-score, P3–P97). Log 100+ sleep sounds and lullabies. Keep a digital memory book, track vaccinations, and watch educational clips for ages 0–5. Available in 21 languages. Freemium — lifetime premium unlock available.

records.name: TaskBill — Cost-Per-Task Benchmark Kit
records.tagline: Measure what YOUR task costs across LLM models
records.description: Per-1M token prices don't answer "what does MY task cost." TaskBill is a measurement kit: run a workload N times across providers and get a finance-ready cost-per-task report (mean, p50, p90, cache-hit vs miss split). You get: a measurement runbook (trial hygiene: warmups, outlier handling, tokenizer notes), a stdlib-only CLI — your API keys stay on your machine — results.csv template, a one-page finance-summary template, and a sourced Oct 2026 price table. by Haku · $29 one-time.

records.name: 12Testers14Day
records.tagline: Google Play closed testing: 12 real testers, 14 days
records.description: Stop chasing testers. Focus on building your app. 12Testers14Day helps Android developers run Google Play closed testing with 12+ real testers over 14 days. We coordinate tester opt-ins, monitor participation, and provide a closeout report to support your production-access application. Get real-device testing, useful feedback, and visibility into your testing progress—all in one dashboard. Built for indie developers, startups, and agencies preparing to launch on Google Play.

records.name: Paywint Instant ACH
records.tagline: Instant ACH transfers for US businesses
records.description: Paywint's Instant ACH Transfer Online helps US businesses send and receive ACH payments faster, without the multi-day wait of traditional bank transfers. Add payee details, authorize the payment, and track its status in real time from one dashboard. Send batch transfers for payroll, suppliers, and client payments, get instant notifications, and manage everything from the web or mobile app.

records.name: PTJourney Listing Skill
records.tagline: AI listing skill for Ozon, Wildberries and TEMU
records.description: Independent Agent Skill for PTJourney product listing and task management. Prepare 1688 product data, check marketplace requirements and manage authorized Ozon, Wildberries (WB) and TEMU listing tasks through a signed-in Windows client and local MCP. Skill documents and configuration examples are MIT-0; product clients, source code and runtime packages are excluded. Requires a product account and local connection. Publisher: qique. Brand: 企雀AI助手.

records.name: Mudbase BaaS
records.tagline: The backend that gets your product paid.
records.description: Building a product shouldn't mean stitching together your backend across different providers and payment infrastructure. Mudbase gives developers the backend infrastructure to build, ship and monetize products, with payments built in. Get authentication, database, storage, realtime, functions, APIs, webhooks and messaging in one backend, then manage the payment lifecycle from checkout to confirmation, access and payout without maintaining a separate payment stack.

records.name: Cooking Dojo Launch
records.tagline: Learn to Cook. One skill at a time.
records.description: Learn to cook. One skill at a time. Cooking Dojo is Duolingo for cooking—bite-sized lessons that build kitchen confidence. Master techniques one at a time and level up from white belt to culinary pro. Built for people who want to cook better. Nailing a sear, understanding flavor, conquering recipes—we break it down into skills you can master. Plus: White Belt Kitchen podcast with real cooking stories and mindset shifts that stick. Stop scrolling recipes. Start becoming the cook you want to be.

records.name: SolFoundry
records.tagline: Trust-first Solana launchpad: locked LP, anti-sniper fees
records.description: SolFoundry is the trust-first Solana launchpad. Launch a token in minutes with locked liquidity, anti-sniper fee scheduler, and permanent metadata. No code, no upsells.

records.name: OfEngine
records.tagline: Launch your own creator platform without the SaaS fees
records.description: Launch your own creator-monetization site. OfEngine is the self-hosted script for subscription content, PPV, paid DMs, livestreaming, AI fan replies, and multi-creator agency mode. Works for fan clubs, paid communities, coaching, fitness, music, and membership sites. Keep 100% of revenue.

records.name: EcoWorld 5th
records.tagline: Thoughtfully Planned 3BHK Homes for Comfortable Family Livin
records.description: EcoWorld 5th is a residential project in Sirsi Road, Vaishali Nagar Extension, Jaipur, offering thoughtfully planned 2, 3, 4 and 5 BHK homes for modern family living. The project features a low-density approach with 88 homes and only eight apartments on each floor, creating a more comfortable and private residential environment. Designed with practical living in mind, EcoWorld 5th includes a range of lifestyle and everyday amenities along with well-planned apartment spaces.

records.name: Animatoa
records.tagline: Turn photos into cinematic 3D motion videos in minutes
records.description: Animatoa lets you turn static product photos into professional 3D motion videos right in your browser. Drop your photo, pick from a growing library of 3D showcase styles, tweak live, and export 9:16, 1:1, and 16:9 sizes in one single pass. No timelines, no complex rendering queues, and 100% local rendering—your files never leave your device. Perfect for E-commerce sellers, founders, and creators looking for premium product videos without the After Effects complexity.

records.name: Playlist Duration
records.tagline: How long is that YouTube course? Plan when you'll finish it
records.description: YouTube shows how many videos a playlist has, never how long it takes. Paste a playlist, channel or video link to get the total of every video (up to 5,000, not just the first 100) and the time at 1.25× to 2× speed. Then pick minutes a day to get a finish date and calendar events. Compare courses side by side, or add the free Chrome, Firefox or Edge extension to see the total on YouTube itself. Free, no signup. Not affiliated with YouTube.

records.name: WP Bones
records.tagline: Laravel-style framework for WordPress plugins
records.description: WP Bones gives a WordPress plugin the shape of a modern PHP app: service providers, Blade views, Eloquent models, migrations and a bones CLI that scaffolds, renames and deploys. New since the first launch, in 33 releases: • 3.0: secure defaults, admin-only pages, nonces on forms, migrations once per site • A webpack build for React and TypeScript apps • 14 boilerplates you can open in WordPress Playground • 350 tests on PHP 8.1–8.4. Free and open source (LGPL).

records.name: Postquel
records.tagline: Free native Postgres app for Mac with your own AI agents
records.description: A fast, native PostgreSQL client for macOS. Its AI assistant runs on the Claude Code, Codex or Cursor account you already pay for, sees your real schema, and can only read: any change it suggests waits for you to dry-run and apply. Free and open source.

records.name: Feedback Bench by Enterpret
records.tagline: AI agents, ranked weekly by what users actually say
records.description: Feedback Bench ranks AI agents by what users actually say about them. Our first bench covers coding agents. We read 287,903 posts from 101,338 users across Reddit, X and beyond, and scored 17 agents on 63 criteria in 9 areas. Benchmarks tell you what's possible. Users tell you what's real. Compare any two head to head, see where each wins on price, limits and reliability, and find the best fit for how you work. New rankings every week, with personal agents up next. Built by Enterpret.

records.name: ParakeetAI 2.0
records.tagline: The ultimate way to prepare for your job interview
records.description: ParakeetAI takes you from "what will they ask?" to "I nailed it." Start with the Question Bank: real interview questions grouped by company and ranked by how often they come up. Rehearse them out loud with an AI interviewer that asks, listens and follows up on your answers, then read the transcript back. On the day, ParakeetAI listens to the real interview and drafts your answers live. Your first mock interview is free.

records.name: MacAway
records.tagline: Locks your Mac when you walk away, no app on your phone
records.description: MacAway sits in your menu bar and does one thing: it locks your Mac when you walk away. Setup takes a minute. Pick the iPhone or Apple Watch you already carry, and you are done. Nothing to install on the phone, no account, nothing to tune. The menu says in plain words whether you are protected, and one switch pauses it when you want to stay put. If it ever locks while you are still there, it tells you why and offers the one fix. 14 days free, then $14 once for all your Macs.

records.name: Anchor
records.tagline: Prevent ChatGPT from jumping to new responses while you read
records.description: When ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini streams a new reply, the page often jumps to the bottom and you lose your place. Anchor is a free Chrome extension that holds your scroll while you read. Scroll up mid-reply, finish the paragraph, then jump back when you want. Works on ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini. No account. No paywall. Just calmer reading during long AI answers - 55 installs and counting :)

records.name: GhostBed Climate Pro™
records.tagline: Dual-zone cooling & heating for better sleep
records.description: GhostBed Climate Pro™ is a dual-zone, water-based heating and cooling mattress cover that gives each sleeper precise, independent temperature control. Adjust each side from the Control Hub or free app, track sleep with built-in biometrics, and enjoy personalized comfort without monthly subscription fees.

records.name: Hotel Lobby AI
records.tagline: Turn any two photos into a viral orange-booth duet video
records.description: Hotel Lobby AI turns two photos (friends, couples, pets or cartoon characters) into a short duet video staged in the minimalist orange recording booth that's all over TikTok and Reels. No prompts, no editing: drop one photo per performer and get a watermark-free vertical 9:16 or 4:3 video in minutes. Your first video is free, no card needed. Then $4.99 for 3 videos, or a monthly plan. Failed videos are refunded, and uploaded photos are deleted after generation.

records.name: Hypothesis Testing
records.tagline: Hypothesis Testing Quiz
records.description: Hypothesis Testing Quiz

records.name: Leavelift
records.tagline: Find the best PTO dates for your next long break
records.description: Leavelift turns your PTO allowance, holidays, and location into a clear set of dates for longer breaks. Start a free PTO plan and see which dates may work best for you. I’m the founder/maker of Leavelift and I’m sharing this launch to learn where the planner is useful or confusing. Results depend on the inputs you provide and your employer’s calendar; review dates before requesting time off.

records.name: Geopoch
records.tagline: Guess the event, place and year from historical clues
records.description: Where was it, and when? Five daily puzzles from history, science, art and music: drop a pin on the globe and guess the year. Free, no sign-up. GEOPOCH is a daily browser game where you identify a historical event from a sequence of clues, then place it in time and on the map. Built for people who enjoy history, deduction and a small daily challenge.

records.name: TOM — The Outreach Machine
records.tagline: The all-in-one sales engagement & outreach platform
records.description: AI-personalized sales follow-ups, sending and replies in one platform: TOM reads every prospect's website before it writes. From $19 per mailbox, no platform fee, in 21 languages. It handles domains, mailboxes, verification, timing and replies, with unsubscribe, bounce handling and opt-out controls built into the flow. Start with a single mailbox at $19/month, no platform access fee, AI included. Add mailboxes as you grow.

records.name: Softrixa
records.tagline: Free AI App Builder — Build websites & apps by chatting
records.description: Softrixa is a free AI agent that builds complete websites, web apps and games from a chat prompt. Live preview, code view, one-file or ZIP download. Powered by RRR PRO MEX.

records.name: PiazzaPost
records.tagline: AI posts for your local business in 30 seconds.
records.description: PiazzaPost writes social media captions for small local businesses in 30 seconds. Upload 1-5 photos → pick a tone (friendly, professional, ironic, elegant) → get ready-to-publish captions for 8 platforms (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Google Business, LinkedIn, X, Pinterest, YouTube) in 12 languages. What makes it different: most AI tools write like a press release. PiazzaPost writes like the owner. Concrete details from the photo, no invented facts, no generic agency fluff.

records.name: Chitmark
records.tagline: Stop agents from farming your free tier
records.description: One API returns allow, challenge, or deny for any costly action in under 50 ms, then improves the next decision based on what happened: credit burn, conversion, chargeback. No browser fingerprinting required. Free tier: 10,000 events/month, no card required.

records.name: Docmino
records.tagline: Interactive guides for learning, planning, and doing
records.description: Turn your ideas into interactive guides people can use again and again. Create lessons with instant feedback, workout plans with timers, recipes with adjustable servings, and forms with built-in charts. Start with a prompt or template, edit in a familiar document editor, and share with a link.

records.name: Virelia Tea
records.tagline: Flash-frozen craft tea pods without teabag microplastics
records.description: Precision-brewed whole organic tea leaves cryo-frozen at -20°C into solid single-serve pods. Drop into hot or iced water to dissolve in 10 seconds. Zero teabag contact, zero microplastics, and 90%+ intact native EGCG catechins.

records.name: MapLark
records.tagline: Turn OpenStreetMap into an API your app can call
records.description: Query real-world OpenStreetMap data - buildings, roads, parks, and more - via the MapLark OSM Features API. GeoJSON, FlatGeobuf, GeoParquet, or CSV. Open standards, no vendor lock-in. Geocoding, routing, and MCP also available to build geospatial apps with. Ask for cafes, buildings, or streets and get GeoJSON, opening hours, and walk or bike routes. Free tier. Try a query in minutes.
